fullPassage: It would be hard to overstate how important meaningful work is to human beings— work that provides a sense of fulfillment and empowerment. Those who have found deeper meaning in their careers find their days much more energizing and satisfying, and count their employment as one of their greatest sources of joy and pride. Sonya Lyubomirsky, professor of psychology at the University of California, has conducted numerous workplace studies showing that when people are more fulfilled on the job, they not only produce higher quality work and a greater output, but also generally earn higher incomes. Those most satisfied with their work are also much more likely to be happier with their lives overall. For her book Happiness at Work, researcher Jessica Pryce-Jones conducted a study of 3,000 workers in seventy-nine countries, finding that those who took greater satisfaction from their work were 150 percent more likely to have a happier life overall.

det.tip: satisfied(만족하는) ↔ discontented(불만족한). pleased·content·glad는 유사어

questions.passage: It would be hard to <u>overstate</u> how important meaningful work is to human beings— work that provides a sense of fulfillment and empowerment. Those who have found deeper meaning in their careers find their days much more energizing and satisfying, and count their employment as one of their greatest sources of joy and pride. Sonya Lyubomirsky, professor of psychology at the University of California, has conducted numerous workplace studies showing that when people are more fulfilled on the job, they not only produce higher quality work and a greater output, but also generally earn higher incomes. Those most satisfied with their work are also much more likely to be happier with their lives overall. For her book Happiness at Work, researcher Jessica Pryce-Jones conducted a study of 3,000 workers in seventy-nine countries, finding that those who took greater satisfaction from their work were 150 percent more likely to have a happier life overall.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 overstate와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: overstate=과장하다 → understate=축소해서 말하다
det.analysis:
✅ ① understate: understate(축소해서 말하다)는 overstate(과장하다)의 반의어 ←정답
❌ ② exaggerate: exaggerate(과장하다)는 overstate와 유사한 동의어
❌ ③ emphasize: emphasize(강조하다)는 overstate와 유사한 뉘앙스
❌ ④ stress: stress(강조하다)는 overstate와 유사한 의미
det.tip: overstate(과장하다) ↔ understate(축소하다). exaggerate·emphasize·stress는 유사어

questions.passage:
(A) The young children learned to <u>count</u> from one to a hundred during their first year of school.
(B) Those who have found deeper meaning in their careers count their employment as one of their greatest sources of joy and pride.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 count의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: count: (A) 아이들이 수를 세다(동사) / (B) count A as B = A를 B로 여기다/간주하다
det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 수를 세다 — (B) ~로 여기다/간주하다: (A)는 1부터 100까지 수를 세다, (B) count their employment as ~는 자신의 일을 ~로 여기다라는 뜻으로 다의어의 두 의미를 올바르게 연결 ←정답
❌ ② (A) 중요하다 — (B) ~로 여기다: (A)의 count는 '중요하다'가 아니라 '수를 세다'
❌ ③ (A) 수를 세다 — (B) 계산: (B)의 count는 명사 '계산'이 아닌 동사 '~로 여기다'
❌ ④ (A) 의지하다 — (B) 수를 세다: (A)는 '의지하다'가 아니라 '수를 세다', (B)는 '수를 세다'가 아니라 '여기다'
det.tip: count: ① (동사) 수를 세다 ② count A as B=A를 B로 여기다 ③ (동사) 중요하다 ④ count on=의지하다

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "money that a person regularly receives from work or investments"

det.korean: income=소득/수입 (일이나 투자에서 정기적으로 받는 돈)
det.analysis:
❌ ① output: output(생산량)은 만들어낸 산출물이지 받는 돈이 아님
✅ ② income: income(소득)은 일이나 투자에서 정기적으로 받는 돈으로 영영 정의와 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ career: career(경력/직업)는 직업 활동이지 받는 돈이 아님
❌ ④ pride: pride(자부심)는 감정으로 돈과 무관
det.tip: income = 소득. money regularly received from work가 핵심

questions.passage: Those who have found deeper meaning in their careers find their days much more energizing and __________ (satisfy), and count their employment as one of their greatest sources of joy and pride. Those most satisfied with their work are also much more likely to be happier with their lives overall.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: energizing과 and로 병렬되는 현재분사형 형용사 satisfying (만족스러운)
det.analysis: 'much more energizing and __________'에서 앞의 현재분사형 형용사 energizing과 and로 병렬되는 자리이므로, 동사 satisfy가 아니라 현재분사형 형용사 satisfying이 와야 한다. satisfy → satisfying
det.tip: energizing and satisfying = 활력을 주고 만족스러운 (현재분사형 형용사 병렬)

questions.passage: It would be hard to overstate how __________ (importance) meaningful work is to human beings— work that provides a sense of fulfillment and empowerment. Those who have found deeper meaning in their careers find their days much more energizing and satisfying.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: how 뒤에서 형용사로 쓰여 meaningful work의 중요성을 나타내는 important
det.analysis: 'how __________ meaningful work is'에서 how 뒤에 형용사가 와서 '얼마나 중요한지'를 나타내는 자리이므로, 명사 importance가 아니라 형용사 important가 와야 한다. importance → important
det.tip: how + 형용사 + 주어 + 동사: how important ~ is (얼마나 중요한지)

questions.passage: It would be hard to overstate how important meaningful work is to human beings— work that provides a __________ and empowerment. Those most satisfied with their work are also much more likely to be happier with their lives overall. For her book Happiness at Work, researcher Jessica Pryce-Jones conducted a study of 3,000 workers in seventy-nine countries, finding that those who took greater satisfaction from their work were 150 percent more likely to have a happier life overall.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: sense of fulfillment=성취감 — 의미 있는 일은 성취감과 권한 부여를 준다
det.analysis:
❌ ① loss of control(통제력 상실): 의미 있는 일이 주는 긍정적 효과와 반대
❌ ② waste of time(시간 낭비): 중요한 일이라는 맥락과 반대
❌ ③ fear of failure(실패의 두려움): 성취감·권한 부여라는 긍정적 맥락과 반대
✅ ④ sense of fulfillment(성취감): 'work that provides a _____ and empowerment'에서 의미 있는 일이 성취감(sense of fulfillment)과 권한 부여를 준다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: work that provides a sense of fulfillment and empowerment — 성취감과 권한 부여를 주는 일

questions.passage: It would be hard to overstate how important meaningful work is to human beings— work that provides a sense of fulfillment and empowerment. Those who have found deeper meaning in their careers find their days much more energizing and satisfying, and count their employment as one of their greatest sources of joy and pride. Sonya Lyubomirsky, professor of psychology at the University of California, has conducted numerous workplace studies showing that when people are more fulfilled on the job, they not only produce higher quality work and a greater output, but also generally earn higher incomes. Those most satisfied with their work are also much more likely to be happier with their lives overall. For her book Happiness at Work, researcher Jessica Pryce-Jones conducted a study of 3,000 workers in seventy-nine countries, finding that those who __________ their work were 150 percent more likely to have a happier life overall.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: took greater satisfaction from=~에서 더 큰 만족을 얻었다 — 일에서 더 큰 만족을 얻은 사람이 더 행복하다
det.analysis:
❌ ① ran away from(~에서 도망쳤다): 더 행복한 삶이라는 긍정적 결과와 연결되지 않음
❌ ② lost interest in(~에 흥미를 잃었다): 만족을 얻는다는 맥락과 반대
✅ ③ took greater satisfaction from(~에서 더 큰 만족을 얻었다): 'those who _____ their work were 150 percent more likely to have a happier life'에서 일에서 더 큰 만족을 얻은 사람이 더 행복한 삶을 살 가능성이 높다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ felt bored by(~에 지루함을 느꼈다): 더 행복한 삶이라는 결과와 반대
det.tip: took greater satisfaction from their work → happier life — 일에서 더 큰 만족을 얻음
